description: Navigate to the USGS Earthquake Hazards Program (earthquake.usgs.gov) and perform a search for all earthquakes that occurred in the calendar year 2024 (2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31) with a minimum magnitude of 6.0. Download the search results as a CSV file and save it to '~/Downloads/earthquake_data.csv'. Review the data and explore at least 2 specific event pages. Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'USGS Earthquake Research' containing at least 3 bookmarks to USGS pages. Finally, write a brief analysis report to '~/Documents/earthquake_analysis.txt' that includes: (1) the total number of M6.0+ earthquakes found, (2) details of the strongest earthquake of the year, (3) a list of at least 5 significant events, and (4) a brief summary of geographic patterns.
